```{r, seagrass data}
seagrass = read_csv("D:/seagrass/seagrass biomass.csv") %>%
  filter(`Year obs` >= 1995 & `Year obs` <= 2019)
summary(seagrass)


sf_use_s2(FALSE)

seagrass_sf <- st_as_sf(seagrass,
                        coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
                        crs = 4326)
mpa_global_proj <- st_transform(mpa_global, 54009)  # Mollweide equal-area
seagrass_sf_proj <- st_transform(seagrass_sf, 54009)

seagrass_sf_proj <- st_join(seagrass_sf_proj, mpa_global_proj["WDPAID"], left = TRUE)
seagrass_sf_proj$inside_mpa <- ifelse(is.na(seagrass_sf_proj$WDPAID), "Outside MPA", "Inside MPA")

seagrass_buffer <- st_buffer(seagrass_sf_proj, dist = 50000) # buffer in degrees (~50 km)

seagrass_poly <- seagrass_buffer |>
  group_by(`Seagr bioregion`) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) #estimated seagrass polygons
```

```{r}
keep_cols <- intersect(names(mpa_global), c("WDPAID","WDPA_PID","IUCN_CAT","NO_TAKE","STATUS_YR"))
mpa_keep <- mpa_global[, keep_cols]

# Spatial join: seagrass points to MPAs
joined <- st_join(seagrass_sf, mpa_keep, left=TRUE)

# Classification: inside/outside
id_field <- if ("WDPA_PID" %in% names(joined)) "WDPA_PID" else "WDPAID"
joined <- joined %>%
  mutate(inside_mpa = ifelse(is.na(.data[[id_field]]), "Outside MPA", "Inside MPA"),
         fisheries = case_when(
           !is.na(NO_TAKE) & tolower(NO_TAKE) == "all"  ~ "No-take",
           !is.na(NO_TAKE) & tolower(NO_TAKE) == "some" ~ "Partial",
           is.na(.data[[id_field]])                     ~ "Outside",
           TRUE                                         ~ "Multi-use"
         ))

```


```{r}
dat <- joined %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  rename(year = `Year obs`,
         bioregion = `Seagr bioregion`,
         biom_above = `biom above dm [g/m**2]`,
         biom_below = `biom below dm [g/m**2]`,
         biom_tot   = `biom tot dm [g/m**2]`,
         shoot_dens = `shoot dens [#/m**2]`,
         leaf_dens  = `leaf dens [#/m**2]`,
         prod_shoot = `shoot production dm [g/m**2/day]`,
         prod_leaf  = `leaf production dm [g/m**2/day]`,
         prod_tot = `production total dm [g/m**2/day]`,
         cover_pct  = `coverage [%]`) %>%
  mutate(
    C_above = biom_above * 0.35,   # carbon proxy
    C_tot   = biom_tot * 0.35,
    bioregion = factor(bioregion),
    Genus = factor(Genus),
    fisheries = factor(fisheries, levels=c("Outside","Multi-use","Partial","No-take"))
  )

```


```{r, ecological profile}

  summarise(
    n_sites = n(),
    mean_biom_above = mean(biom_above, na.rm=TRUE),
    mean_biom_tot   = mean(biom_tot, na.rm=TRUE),

    mean_prod       = mean(prod_tot, na.rm=TRUE),
```

```{r, overlap coverage analysis}
mpa_eq <- st_transform(mpa_global, 54009)    # Mollweide
sg_eq  <- st_transform(seagrass_polygon, 54009) # requires UNEP-WCMC seagrass polygons
seagrass_points  <- st_transform(seagrass_sf_proj, 54009)      # biomass points with Seagr bioregion
seagrass_polygon <- st_transform(seagrass_polygon, 54009)
poly_with_points <- st_join(seagrass_polygon, seagrass_points["Seagr bioregion"], left = TRUE)

poly_bioregion <- poly_with_points %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(row_id = row_number() %% nrow(seagrass_polygon), `Seagr bioregion`) %>%
  tally() %>%
  group_by(row_id) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)   # keep most frequent bioregion

# 5. Attach bioregion back to polygons
seagrass_polygon$Seagr_bioregion <- poly_bioregion$`Seagr bioregion`

# Intersections
sg_in_mpa <- st_intersection(sg_eq, mpa_eq)
sg_in_mpa$overlap_area <- st_area(sg_in_mpa)

# Summarise by MPA year
overlap_by_year <- sg_in_mpa %>%
  group_by(STATUS_YR) %>%
  summarise(total_overlap = sum(overlap_area, na.rm=TRUE))

# Denominator = global seagrass area
total_seagrass_area <- sum(st_area(sg_eq))

overlap_by_year <- overlap_by_year %>%
  mutate(percent_coverage = (total_overlap / total_seagrass_area) * 100)

overlap_by_year <- overlap_by_year %>%
  mutate(percent_coverage = as.numeric(percent_coverage))

ggplot(overlap_by_year, aes(x=STATUS_YR, y=percent_coverage)) +
  geom_line(color="green", size=1.2) +
  geom_point(color="darkblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y="% of global seagrass protected", x="MPA designation year", title = "Annual increase of MPA among seagrass meadows")

```


```{r, overlap by bioregion}
# Make sure geometries are valid
# Simplify polygons (tolerance in meters, adjust as needed)
sg_eq_simplified  <- st_simplify(st_make_valid(seagrass_polygon), dTolerance = 1000)
mpa_eq_simplified <- st_simplify(st_make_valid(mpa_eq), dTolerance = 1000)


analyze_bioregion <- function(region_name) {
  message("Processing: ", region_name)
  
  # Subset seagrass polygons
  sg_sub <- sg_eq_simplified %>% filter(Seagr_bioregion == region_name)
  if (nrow(sg_sub) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Crop MPAs
  mpa_sub <- tryCatch({
    st_crop(mpa_eq_simplified, st_bbox(sg_sub))
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (is.null(mpa_sub) || nrow(mpa_sub) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Intersections
  sg_mpa_sub <- tryCatch({
    st_intersection(sg_sub, mpa_sub)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  # Area
  overlap_area <- if (!is.null(sg_mpa_sub) && nrow(sg_mpa_sub) > 0) {
    sum(as.numeric(st_area(sg_mpa_sub)), na.rm=TRUE)
  } else 0
  
  total_area <- sum(as.numeric(st_area(sg_sub)), na.rm=TRUE)
  
  coverage <- tibble(
    bioregion = region_name,
    overlap_area = overlap_area,
    area_total = total_area,
    percent_coverage = 100 * overlap_area / total_area
  )
  
  # Map (always print seagrass + MPA, even if no overlap)
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = mpa_sub, fill="lightblue", alpha=0.4, color="blue") +
    geom_sf(data = sg_sub, fill="red", alpha=0.4, color="darkred") +
    {if (overlap_area > 0) geom_sf(data = sg_mpa_sub, fill="purple", alpha=0.7, color="purple")} +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Seagrass vs MPAs in", region_name),
      subtitle = "Red = Seagrass, Blue = MPAs, Purple = Overlap"
    )
  
  print(p)  # 👈 force plotting when the function is called
  
  return(list(coverage = coverage, plot = p))
}


# Apply to all bioregions (skip NA)
unique_bioregions <- na.omit(unique(seagrass_polygon$Seagr_bioregion))
results <- list()
for (region in unique_bioregions) {
  res <- tryCatch(
    analyze_bioregion(region),
    error = function(e) {
      message("⚠️ Skipping ", region, " due to error: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
  if (!is.null(res)) {
    results[[region]] <- res
    print(res$plot)   # 👈 force plotting here
  }
}


#Combine coverage summaries
coverage_all <- bind_rows(map(results, "coverage"))

#Example: print plot for first region
print(results[[1]]$plot) #Tropical Indo Pacific
print(results[[2]]$plot) #Tropical Atlantic
print(results[[3]]$plot) #Temperate Southern
print(results[[4]]$plot) #Temperate North Atlantic
print(results[[5]]$plot) #Temperate North Pacific
print(results[[6]]$plot) #Mediterranean

#Coverage table
print(coverage_all)


```

```{r, different index}
# 1. Collapse to bioregion × inside_mpa × genus
bioregion_matrix <- dat %>%
  group_by(bioregion, inside_mpa, Genus) %>%
  summarise(total_biomass = mean(biom_above, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Genus, values_from = total_biomass, values_fill = 0)

# 2. Split metadata and abundance matrix
abund_matrix_bioregion <- bioregion_matrix %>% select(-bioregion, -inside_mpa)

# 3. Calculate indices
bioregion_matrix$Simpson  <- diversity(abund_matrix_bioregion, index = "simpson")
bioregion_matrix$Shannon  <- diversity(abund_matrix_bioregion, index = "shannon")
bioregion_matrix$Evenness <- bioregion_matrix$Shannon / log(specnumber(abund_matrix_bioregion))

# 4. Final summary table
div_summary_bioregion <- bioregion_matrix %>%
  select(bioregion, inside_mpa, Simpson, Shannon, Evenness)

print(div_summary_bioregion)

# ---- Optional plot ----
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(div_summary_bioregion, aes(x = bioregion, y = Shannon, fill = inside_mpa)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Seagrass Shannon diversity by Bioregion and MPA status",
       x = "Bioregion", y = "Shannon Index")
div_long <- div_summary_bioregion %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Simpson, Shannon, Evenness),
                      names_to = "Index", values_to = "Value")
```


```{r, overlap by year analysis}
# Requires polygons (sg_eq = seagrass, mpa_eq = MPAs, both equal-area)

total_seagrass_area <- sum(st_area(sg_eq), na.rm=TRUE)

total_seagrass_area <- sum(as.numeric(st_area(sg_eq)), na.rm=TRUE)

calc_cumulative <- function(year) {
  mpa_year <- mpa_eq %>% filter(STATUS_YR <= year)
  sg_in_mpa <- st_intersection(sg_eq, mpa_year)
  overlap_area <- as.numeric(sum(st_area(sg_in_mpa), na.rm=TRUE))
  total_area   <- as.numeric(total_seagrass_area)

  tibble(
    year = as.integer(year),
    overlap_area = overlap_area,
    percent_coverage = (overlap_area / total_area) * 100
  )
}

years <- 1995:2019
overlap_by_year <- do.call(rbind, lapply(years, calc_cumulative))

str(overlap_by_year) 

ggplot(overlap_by_year, aes(x=year, y=percent_coverage)) +
  geom_line(color="darkgreen", size=1.2) +
  geom_point(color="darkblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y="% of global seagrass protected", x="Year",
       title="Cumulative protection of seagrass in MPAs (1995–2019)") #cumulative coverage

```

```{r, BACI}
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(time_since_MPA = year - STATUS_YR,
         period = case_when(
           inside_mpa == "Outside MPA" ~ "Control",
           time_since_MPA < 0          ~ "Before",
           time_since_MPA >= 0         ~ "After"
         ))

baci_summary <- dat %>%
  group_by(period, inside_mpa) %>%
  summarise(mean_biomass = mean(biom_above, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

ggplot(baci_summary, aes(x=period, y=mean_biomass, fill=inside_mpa)) +
  geom_col(position="dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title="BACI biomass comparison")

```

```{r, seagrass community composition}
# 1. Build site × genus matrix
site_species <- dat %>%
  group_by(SiteID, Genus, inside_mpa, fisheries, year, bioregion) %>%
  summarise(biomass = mean(biom_above, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Genus,
                     values_from = biomass,
                     values_fill = 0)

# 2. Extract abundance-only matrix
abund_matrix <- site_species %>%
  select(-SiteID, -inside_mpa, -fisheries, -year, -bioregion)

# 3. Replace NAs with zeros
abund_matrix[is.na(abund_matrix)] <- 0

# 4. Calculate row totals (total biomass per site)
row_totals <- rowSums(abund_matrix)

# 5. Drop empty rows (sites with all zeros)
abund_matrix_clean <- abund_matrix[row_totals > 0, ]

# Also drop corresponding rows from metadata
site_species_clean <- site_species[row_totals > 0, ]



# Run PCA safely
pca <- prcomp(as.matrix(abund_matrix_clean), scale.=TRUE)
summary(pca)

# PERMANOVA

perm <- adonis2(
  abund_matrix_clean ~ inside_mpa,
  data = site_species_clean,
  permutations = 999,
  method = "bray"
)
print(perm)
```

```{r, PCA plots}
# Extract PCA scores (only sites that made it into abund_matrix_clean)

nrow(pca_scores)
nrow(site_species_clean)
dim(abund_matrix_clean)
dim(site_species_clean)

# Extract scores for first 2 axes
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[,1:2])
stopifnot(nrow(pca_scores) == nrow(site_species_clean))

# Double-check row counts
nrow(abund_matrix_clean)        # should be 2882
nrow(pca$x)                     # must also be 2882


# Attach metadata from site_species_clean
pca_scores$inside_mpa <- site_species_clean$inside_mpa
pca_scores$bioregion  <- site_species_clean$bioregion
pca_scores$year       <- site_species_clean$year

# Plot PCA

ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=inside_mpa, shape=bioregion)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title="PCA of Seagrass Community Composition",
    subtitle="Colored by MPA status, shaped by bioregion",
    x="PC1", y="PC2")
```

```{r, result extraction}
# ---- 1. LINEAR & MIXED MODELS ----
all_model_results <- bind_rows(

)

fishery = bind_rows(
  broom.mixed::tidy(fit_lmm_fish, effects="fixed") %>% mutate(model="lmm_fish_totbio"),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fit_lmm_fish_prod_tot, effects="fixed") %>% mutate(model="lmm__fish_prod_tot"),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fit_lmm_fish_cover, effects="fixed") %>% mutate(model="lmm_cover_pct")
)
# ---- 2. VARIANCE TEST ----
levene_df <- as.data.frame(car::leveneTest(biom_tot ~ inside_mpa, data=dat))

# ---- 3. DIVERSITY INDICES ----
div_summary <- site_species %>%
  group_by(inside_mpa) %>%
  summarise(mean_simpson = mean(Simpson, na.rm=TRUE),
            mean_shannon = mean(Shannon, na.rm=TRUE),
            mean_even    = mean(Evenness, na.rm=TRUE))

# ---- 4. PERMANOVA ----
perm_results <- as.data.frame(perm)
perm_results$Factor <- rownames(perm_results)
rownames(perm_results) <- NULL

# ---- 5. PCA ----
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
pca_scores <- cbind(pca_scores, site_species_clean[,c("SiteID","inside_mpa","bioregion","year")])
pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation)
pca_var_df <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", 1:length(pca$sdev)),
  Variance_explained = round((pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)) * 100, 2)
)

# ---- 6. CLUSTERING ----
cluster_assignments <- dat %>%
  select(SiteID, year, bioregion, inside_mpa) %>%
  mutate(cluster = dat$cluster)
cluster_centers <- as.data.frame(km$centers) %>%
  mutate(cluster = row_number())

# ---- 7. BACI ----
baci_summary <- dat %>%
  group_by(period, inside_mpa) %>%
  summarise(mean_biomass = mean(biom_above, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

# ---- 8. LAGGED EFFECT ----

# ---- 9. OVERLAP COVERAGE ----

# ---- EXPORT ALL ----
```

```{r}
sg_sub <- sg_eq %>% filter(Seagr_bioregion == region_name)
  
  # Crop MPAs to bounding box of region
  mpa_sub <- st_crop(mpa_eq, st_bbox(sg_sub))
  
  # Union *only this subset* to avoid double-counting
  mpa_sub_union <- st_union(mpa_sub)
  
  # Intersections
  sg_mpa_sub <- st_intersection(sg_sub, mpa_sub_union)
  
  # Area calculations
  sg_sub$area_total <- as.numeric(st_area(sg_sub))
  sg_mpa_sub$area_overlap <- as.numeric(st_area(sg_mpa_sub))
  
  # Coverage summary
  coverage <- sg_mpa_sub %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    summarise(overlap_area = sum(area_overlap, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(bioregion = region_name,
           area_total = sum(sg_sub$area_total, na.rm=TRUE),
           percent_coverage = 100 * overlap_area / area_total)
```
